title: GME Chain exchange
tagline: The documented exchange contracts on GME Chain mainnet (12821) from block 0: Wrapped GME, bridged USDG, the Uniswap V2 factory and router, the GME/USDG pair and the token bridge. The chain is young, so the history is short. USDG has 6 decimals.

queries.title: Latest USDG transfers
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, "from", "to", CAST(value_dec AS DOUBLE) / 1e6 AS usdg FROM usdg__transfer ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Pairs the factory has created
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, token0, token1, pair FROM factory__pair_created ORDER BY block_number

queries.title: Swaps on the GME/USDG pair
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, sender, "to", amount0In_dec, amount1In_dec, amount0Out_dec, amount1Out_dec FROM pair__swap ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Pool reserves over time
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, reserve0_dec, reserve1_dec FROM pair__sync ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Wrapped GME deposits
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, block_timestamp, dst, wad_dec FROM wgme__deposit ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 20

prompts: List every table in this nest with its row count and say which have data.
Which pairs has the Uniswap V2 factory created, and what are their two tokens? Use factory__pair_created.
What are the latest reserves of the GME/USDG pair, from pair__sync? USDG has 6 decimals, WGME has 18.
Who has deposited GME into Wrapped GME, and how much? Use wgme__deposit, wad_dec divided by 1e18.
How many USDG transfers are there and who received the most? Use usdg__transfer, value_dec divided by 1e6.
